description: The Technical University of Darmstadt team publishes the ETA Factory Thermal System Operation framework for benchmarking industrial heating-network controllers. Zenodo archives release 1.1.1; the linked repository identifies a BSD 2-Clause licence, while Zenodo labels BSD-2-Clause-NetBSD. The Python package includes a high-temperature heating-network use case, simulation and live environments, an FMU, OPC UA mappings, scenario utilities and rule-based, model-predictive, reinforcement-learning and market-based controller components. This platform can compare control policies in simulation and prepare transfer to the ETA research factory. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this specialised heating-network framework. Coverage is the stated factory use case and its configurations, not a generic model of every industrial heat system. A limitation is that live deployment needs compatible equipment and interfaces; public repository structure alone does not verify a successful physical transfer. The FMU and controller dependencies were not installed, no source archive was downloaded and no control run was reproduced.
